development_screen: Verified primary full-coverage Jan-Apr ledger: all months nonnegative, arithmetic mean at least10%, at least10completed actual trades. Diagnostic routes cannot rescue a failed primary. This screen does not replace original case acceptance.
acceptance: May/July/September full net capital month arithmetic mean at least10%; all May-September months nonnegative and full coverage. No month-specific fitting or extra future observation period gate. Exposed historical data remain development regression.
capital: Original settled-cash rule, allocation0/1 only; at most one ETF, no leverage, same-day reentry forbidden, T+1 and available dividend cash handled normally. V25 full-cash/dividend wait rule is not applied. All fees/slippage, dividends/splits, cross-month MTM and unknown-held occupation retained. Cash0 does not meet growth objective.

case_rule: No new May-Sep model/capital evaluation unless independently verified PRIMARY development passes. Data extension and exact development-prefix check required before cases. Existing history remains exposed development regression.
hypothesis: Does a low-dimensional identity-centered class bias, learned on past as-issued source-eligible top candidates, repair ordinary-stop underestimation while preserving source direction and payoff support? v12/v24 probability calibration and v37-v40 candidate filtering already failed; this is a bounded class-bias/selection-population experiment, not first calibration.
inputs: Exact v78 semiconductor panel, gap_blend as-issued probabilities/events/class-payoff means, unchanged old capital labels and fees; no new market data or base-model retraining.
calibration_population: Daily00ET own semiconductor continuous fully mature14day prefix. Keep latest120/min60 parent dates whose every clock has as-issued ready gap_blend. Need at least30 dates with source-eligible candidates. eligible: only source then-eligible top; top: all source tops; both: both ETFs. Source eligibility determined before account occupation. No actual-fill or future-outcome selection. All new routes share population readiness and support gates.
weights: Use half-life63 positions in the latest120 full parent dates; do not compress ages after eligible selection. Each included date has total raw weight b; divide across included rows. Normalize to ESS=(sum b)^2/sum b^2 separately per population; real counts and ESS retained. Multiple clocks/ETFs do not increase date count.
model: Four shared class-bias parameters beta. q_j=p_j*exp(beta_j)/sum(p*exp(beta)); fixed identity log-prob slopes, zero probabilities stay zero. Minimize weighted multinomial log loss plus5*||beta||^2; lambda10 all coefficients. Initial beta0 is identity. No extra context, class-payoff regression, reranking, monetary weighting, or additive return residual.
missing_support: Any training row with issued true-class probability0 makes that population unready; never drop that row or smooth zero to fake support. Shared new-route gate requires every population fit-ready. Incomplete labels excluded only by original chronological maturity prefix.
solver: Exact4x4Hessian damped Newton,max80,gradient1e-9 target and1e-7 required. Armijo backtracking up to50; allow64eps objective roundoff only when gradient halves. Strictlyconvex lambda10. Independent gradient/Hessian and scipy L-BFGS real anchors.
decision: Keep source top unchanged and never promote a source CASH. PRIMARY eligible_tilt accepts source-eligible top only if tilted expected netlog return>1e-12. Tie sourceSOXL. identity and top_tilt/both_tilt controls have matched readiness; original source_blend/source_prior/source_raw/source_merged exact controls. Probabilities do not authorize buying the other ETF. Fixed0/1 settledcash.
verification: Independent chronological prefix and every historical candidate member/weight, convex gradient and probabilities, action direction/abstention,11capitalbooks,monthly statistics; four old controls byte-identical. Proper scores for all/top/eligible/actual populations remain separate. Preflight and source hashes frozen before new capital.
